IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: EMPOWERING GENERATIONS OF OPEN SOURCE INNOVATORS.
IRS990.MissionDesc: THE LINUX FOUNDATION SUPPORTS THE CREATION OF SUSTAINABLE OPEN SOURCE ECOSYSTEMS BY PROVIDING FINANCIAL AND INTELLECTUAL RESOURCES, INFRASTRUCTURE, EVENTS, TRAINING, AND SUPPORTING PROGRAMS TO PROGRESS OPEN INNOVATION. WORKING TOGETHER WITH ITS MEMBERS AND COMMUNITIES OF OPEN SOURCE ENGINEERS, THE LINUX FOUNDATION AND ITS PROJECTS FORM THE MOST AMBITIOUS AND SUCCESSFUL INVESTMENT IN THE CREATION OF SHARED TECHNOLOGY.
IRS990.Desc: EVENTS: OUR EVENTS TEAM FACILITATED 219 IN-PERSON EVENTS WITH OVER 70,000 ATTENDEES FROM 162 COUNTRIES REPRESENTING OVER 9,000 DISTINCT ORGANIZATIONS, MARKING THE FIRST YEAR THAT THE NUMBER OF ATTENDEES EXCEEDED THE NUMBER WHO ATTENDED PRIOR TO THE PANDEMIC. WE PROVIDED OVER $1.6M IN TRAVEL FUNDING AND SCHOLARSHIPS TO THESE EVENTS. OUR PROJECTS ALSO HOSTED 88 VIRTUAL WEBINARS ATTENDED BY OVER 12,800 ATTENDEES.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: TRAINING: IN 2024, OUR TRAINING & EDUCATION TEAM ENROLLED OVER 200,000 LEARNERS INTO E-LEARNING COURSES AND PROVIDED NEARLY 50,000 CERTIFICATIONS TO PROFESSIONALS WHO ARE INCREASING THEIR SKILL BASE. MORE THAN 850 PARTICIPANTS, PRIMARILY COLLEGE STUDENTS, HAVE GRADUATED FROM OUR MENTORSHIP PROGRAMS, WHICH CONTINUE TO EDUCATE A NEW GENERATION OF OPEN SOURCE CONTRIBUTORS, PROVIDING SKILLS THAT WILL GIVE THEM A PATH TO GOOD JOBS. IN MEMORY OF OUR CTO, SHUBHRA KAR, WE ALSO PROVIDED OVER 500 EDUCATION SCHOLARSHIPS TO INDIVIDUALS FROM OVER 110 COUNTRIES.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: PROJECTS: WE HOST MORE OPEN SOURCE PROJECTS THAN ANY OTHER ENTITY IN THE WORLD, PROVIDING THE SUPPORT SERVICES THEY NEED IN ORDER TO FUNCTION. WE SURPASSED 1,000 ACTIVE OPEN SOURCE SOFTWARE AND STANDARDS PROJECTS IN 2024, WITH IMPACTFUL PROJECTS IN NEARLY EVERY TECHNOLOGY NICHE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE LINUX FOUNDATION HAS THREE CLASSES OF MEMBERSHIP: PLATINUM, GOLD, AND SILVER.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 7A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: EACH PLATINUM MEMBER, UP TO A MAXIMUM OF 20, IS ENTITLED TO APPOINT A DIRECTOR. THE GOLD MEMBERS, VOTING TOGETHER AS A SINGLE CLASS, ELECT UP TO THREE DIRECTORS, AND THE SILVER MEMBERS, VOTING TOGETHER AS A SINGLE CLASS, ELECT ONE DIRECTOR.
